title: Sheafified free modules on arbitrary sheaves of generators
statement: On an essentially small site, for a commutative ring sheaf $B$ and a set sheaf $E$, define $B[E]$ by module sheafification of the sectionwise free module presheaf. Its restrictions send $[s]$ to $[s|_V]$ and restrict coefficients. The generator is the sectionwise basis map followed by sheafification. For a ring map $b:B\to B\prime$ and a generator map $e:E\to E\prime$, define the simultaneous semilinear change by linear extension into the scalar-restricted target and module sheafification. The underlying-set functor uses the canonical trivial ULift of the recorded algebraic inverse-image interface. The site convention is [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], the module sheaf category is [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], free modules are [def-weil-pbc-free-module], and the module sheafification is [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification].
